lead: Glass terrarium measuring 20x20x40 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 16.0 liters, vertical format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The tallest model on the 20x20 cm base has 40 cm of height and 16 liters of volume. It takes the same spot on the shelf as the lower models on this base and is 10 cm taller than the 20x20x30. The 3D styrofoam background extends the full height of the back. Ventilation is through mesh vents, which is essential in a tall, narrow terrarium.

Juvenile day geckos use the background and branches to climb to the warmer air near the top, and move lower when they are too warm. That way, 40 cm of height produces a temperature gradient from top to bottom instead of from left to right. Smaller frogs do well with a damper floor and a plant. Tree-dwelling tarantulas build a web tunnel here along the background.

For adult geckos this base becomes cramped, so the next step is the 30x30x40 or 30x30x50. On request we also build 20x20x45 or other sizes in between. You choose the outer film from 34 patterns, and the package arrives by courier. For a changed height or base, count on 7 to 14 days of build time.
